Song Settings audio and image software notices

mpg123: Copyright (c) 1995-2020 by Michael Hipp and others,
free software under the terms of the LGPL v2.1.
See mpg123-LGPL.txt (complete terms), mpg123-source.tar.gz (exact C source),
mpg123-wrapper-source.tar.gz (adapter/build source). No mpg123 C source was
modified. Its independently replaceable WASM module is src/lib/codecs/mpg123.wasm.
Pinned wrapper commit: 8f2428c1cd96b54dab74836c8471ff75fe35cbee
Pinned mpg123 commit: 08247b317163175e62035893af3ff9e71a5dfefd
Use the supplied wrapper Makefile's mpg123-configure / mpg123-decoder targets
with Emscripten; the README documents dependency/configuration/build steps.
Replace the separate WASM file and rebuild the application to use a modified
library. scripts/extract-audio-wasm.mjs extracts unmodified official npm bytes.

wasm-audio-decoders JavaScript adapters: MIT, Ethan Halsall and contributors.
Project source: https://github.com/eshaz/wasm-audio-decoders
Exact npm versions, repository commits and package integrity: provenance.json.
MIT terms are reproduced in wasm-audio-decoders-MIT.txt.
Opus / Vorbis / Ogg: see opus-BSD.txt, vorbis-BSD.txt, ogg-BSD.txt.
No optional Opus speech-enhancement model is used for waveform analysis.

AAC: Symphonia 0.5.4, MPL-2.0 (symphonia-MPL.txt).
Source: https://github.com/pdeljanov/Symphonia/tree/v0.5.4
The Pulse AAC packet adapter and Cargo.lock are in pulse-aac-source.tar.gz.
This adapter uses Rust 1.90.0; Rust MIT/Apache notices are included.
The adapter's transitive crate licenses and checksums are listed in Cargo.lock
and crates-notices.txt. The AAC WASM maximum linear memory is 32 MiB.

jSquash JPEG 1.6.0 / PNG 3.1.1 / WebP 1.5.0: Apache-2.0 wrappers,
plus the individual codec notices in jpeg-codec.txt, png-codec.txt,
webp-codec.txt. Source: https://github.com/jamsinclair/jSquash

Mediabunny 1.61.4: MPL-2.0.
Source: https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny/tree/v1.61.4
See mediabunny-MPL.txt. Used for bounded packet demuxing, without WebCodecs.
@noble/hashes 2.0.1: MIT, Paul Miller. See noble-hashes-MIT.txt.

These notices are included with the application distribution. Codec assets
are bundled locally. No executable codec is loaded from an external CDN.
